description: The effective forward authentication settings: each value, the fields an environment variable sets, and when a change takes effect

anubis_upstream.description: Default Anubis upstream for proxy hosts without their own: scheme://host:port or scheme://cu_name, no path; empty = none (env AUTH_REQUEST_*_UPSTREAM)

tinyauth_upstream.description: Default Tinyauth upstream for proxy hosts without their own: scheme://host:port or scheme://cu_name, no path; empty = none (env AUTH_REQUEST_*_UPSTREAM)

oauth2proxy_upstream.description: Default OAuth2 Proxy upstream for proxy hosts without their own: scheme://host:port or scheme://cu_name, no path; empty = none (env AUTH_REQUEST_*_UPSTREAM)

voidauth_upstream.description: Default VoidAuth upstream for proxy hosts without their own: scheme://host:port or scheme://cu_name, no path; empty = none (env AUTH_REQUEST_*_UPSTREAM)

authelia_upstream.description: Default Authelia upstream for proxy hosts without their own: scheme://host:port or scheme://cu_name, no path; empty = none (env AUTH_REQUEST_*_UPSTREAM)

authentik_upstream.description: Default Authentik upstream for proxy hosts without their own: scheme://host:port or scheme://cu_name, no path; empty = none (env AUTH_REQUEST_*_UPSTREAM)

anubis_custom_images.description: Use the custom Anubis images from /data/public/anubis (env AUTH_REQUEST_ANUBIS_USE_CUSTOM_IMAGES)

locked.description: Fields that cannot be changed because an environment variable sets them, or forces them (see locked_by and locked_reason). A save ignores them (read only)

locked_by.description: For each locked field, the environment variable that sets it. A field locked by its own variable names that variable; a field another setting forces names the variable of that setting (read only)

anubis_upstream.description: Name of the variable that locks the anubis upstream: AUTH_REQUEST_ANUBIS_UPSTREAM

tinyauth_upstream.description: Name of the variable that locks the tinyauth upstream: AUTH_REQUEST_TINYAUTH_UPSTREAM

oauth2proxy_upstream.description: Name of the variable that locks the oauth2proxy upstream: AUTH_REQUEST_OAUTH2PROXY_UPSTREAM

voidauth_upstream.description: Name of the variable that locks the voidauth upstream: AUTH_REQUEST_VOIDAUTH_UPSTREAM

authelia_upstream.description: Name of the variable that locks the authelia upstream: AUTH_REQUEST_AUTHELIA_UPSTREAM

authentik_upstream.description: Name of the variable that locks the authentik upstream: AUTH_REQUEST_AUTHENTIK_UPSTREAM

anubis_custom_images.description: Name of the variable that locks the anubis custom images: AUTH_REQUEST_ANUBIS_USE_CUSTOM_IMAGES

locked_reason.description: Always empty: no field of this section is locked by the variable of another setting

applies.description: When a change of each field takes effect

anubis_upstream.description: When a change of the anubis upstream takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

tinyauth_upstream.description: When a change of the tinyauth upstream takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

oauth2proxy_upstream.description: When a change of the oauth2proxy upstream takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

voidauth_upstream.description: When a change of the voidauth upstream takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

authelia_upstream.description: When a change of the authelia upstream takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

authentik_upstream.description: When a change of the authentik upstream takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

anubis_custom_images.description: When a change of the anubis custom images takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

restart_pending.description: Always empty: every forward authentication setting applies without a container restart
